arxiv-2201-03485.creator: Alexandre Bouayad
arxiv-2201-03485.description: Abstract Résumé On étudie une certaine famille, paramétrée par un entier g ∈ ℕ ≥ 1 g\in\mathbb{N}_{\geq 1} , de doubles déformations U h , h ′ ​ ( 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 2 , g ) {U_{\!\!\>h,h^{\prime}}(\mathfrak{sl}_{2},g)} de l’algèbre enveloppante U 𝕜 ​ ( 𝔰 ​ 𝔩 2 ) {U_{\!\!\;\Bbbk}(\mathfrak{sl}_{2})} , dans l’esprit de Frenkel-Hernandez [ 15 ] .

arxiv-2207-03995.title: Near horizon thermodynamics of hairy black holes from gravitational decoupling
arxiv-2207-03995.creator: R. T. Cavalcanti ID ​​, K. dos S. Alves, J. M. Hoff da Silva ID ​​
arxiv-2207-03995.description: Abstract The horizon structure and thermodynamics of hairy spherically symmetric black holes generated by the gravitational decoupling method are carefully investigated. The temperature and heat capacity of the black hole is determined, as well as how the hairy parameters affect the thermodynamics. It allows the analysis of the thermal stability and the possible existence of a remanent black hole.

arxiv-2211-10907.title: Quantifying the Individual Differences of Driver’ Risk Perception with Just Four Interpretable Parameters Journal: TBD
arxiv-2211-10907.creator: Chen Chen, Zhiqian Lan, Guojian Zhan, Yao Lyu, Bingbing Nie, Shengbo Eben Li
arxiv-2211-10907.description: Abstract There will be a long time when automated vehicles are mixed with human-driven vehicles. Understanding how drivers assess driving risks and modelling their individual differences are significant for automated vehicles to develop human-like and customized behaviors, so as to gain people’s trust and acceptance.

arxiv-2303-14420.title: Human Preference Score: Better Aligning Text-to-Image Models with Human Preference
arxiv-2303-14420.creator: Xiaoshi Wu, Keqiang Sun, Feng Zhu, Rui Zhao, Hongsheng Li
arxiv-2303-14420.description: Abstract Recent years have witnessed a rapid growth of deep generative models, with text-to-image models gaining significant attention from the public. However, existing models often generate images that do not align well with human preferences, such as awkward combinations of limbs and facial expressions.

arxiv-2312-00966.title: Spectral Temporal Contrastive Learning
arxiv-2312-00966.creator: Sacha Morin, Somjit Nath, Samira Ebrahimi Kahou, Guy Wolf
arxiv-2312-00966.description: Abstract Learning useful data representations without requiring labels is a cornerstone of modern deep learning. Self-supervised learning methods, particularly contrastive learning (CL), have proven successful by leveraging data augmentations to define positive pairs. This success has prompted a number of theoretical studies to better understand CL and investigate theoretical bounds for downstream linear probing tasks.

arxiv-2403-20011.title: Influence of pressure anisotropy on mass-radius relation and stability of millisecond pulsars in f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravity
arxiv-2403-20011.creator: Abdul Aziz
arxiv-2403-20011.description: Abstract In this study we explore the astrophysical implications of pressure anisotropy on the physical characteristics of millisecond pulsars within the framework of f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravity, in particular f ⁡ ( Q ) = − α ​ Q − β f(Q)=-\alpha\,Q-\beta , where α \alpha and β \beta are constants.

arxiv-2405-16922.title: Theories of synaptic memory consolidation and intelligent plasticity for continual learning
arxiv-2405-16922.creator: Friedemann Zenke, Axel Laborieux
arxiv-2405-16922.description: Abstract Abstract Humans and animals learn throughout life. Such continual learning is crucial for intelligence. In this chapter, we examine the pivotal role plasticity mechanisms with complex internal synaptic dynamics could play in enabling this ability in neural networks. By surveying theoretical research, we highlight two fundamental enablers for continual learning.

arxiv-2408-16826.title: QSO MUSEUM. II. Search for extended Ly α \alpha emission around eight z ∼ 3 z\sim 3 quasar pairs
arxiv-2408-16826.creator: Eileen Herwig, Fabrizio Arrigoni Battaia, Jay González Lobos, Emanuele P. Farina, Allison W. S. Man, Eduardo Bañados, Guinevere Kauffmann, Zheng Cai, Aura Obreja, J. Xavier Prochaska
arxiv-2408-16826.description: Abstract Extended Ly α \alpha emission is routinely found around single quasars across cosmic time. However, few studies have investigated how such emission changes in fields with physically associated quasar pairs, which should reside in dense environments and are predicted to be linked through intergalactic filaments.

arxiv-2409-05795.title: Environmental dependence on galaxy-halo connections for satellites using HSC weak lensing 2024 Environmental dependence on galaxy-halo connections for satellites using HSC weak lensing – A1
arxiv-2409-05795.creator: Amit. Kumar, Surhud More
arxiv-2409-05795.description: Abstract We present the luminosity-halo mass relations of satellite (sLHMRs) galaxies in the SDSS redMaPPer cluster catalogue and the effects of the dense cluster environment on subhalo mass evolution. We use data from the Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam survey Year-3 catalogue of galaxy shapes to measure the weak lensing signal around these satellites.

arxiv-2508-00671.title: Chemical abundances of seven stars in the GD-1 stream
arxiv-2508-00671.creator: Jing-Kun Zhao, Guang-Wei Li, Wako Aoki, Gang Zhao, Guo-Chao Yang, Jian-Rong Shi, Hai-Ning Li, Tadafumi Matsuno, Miho Ishigaki, Takuma Suda, Satoshi Honda, Yu-Qin Chen, Qian-Fan Xing, Hong-Liang Yan, Yong Yang, Xian-Hao Ye
arxiv-2508-00671.description: Abstract We present the first detailed chemical abundances for seven GD-1 stream stars from Subaru/HDS spectroscopy. Atmospheric parameters were derived via color calibrations ( T eff T\rm_{eff} ) and iterative spectroscopic analysis. LTE abundances for 14 elements ( α \alpha , odd-Z, iron-peak, n-capture) were measured. Six stars trace the main orbit, one resides in a ‘blob’.

arxiv-2510-25619.title: Photoelectric detection of single spins in diamond by optically controlled discharge of long-lived trap states
arxiv-2510-25619.creator: A. C. Ulibarri, D. J. McCloskey, D. Wang, N. Dontschuk, A. M. Martin, A. A. Wood
arxiv-2510-25619.description: Abstract Electrical detection methods for solid-state spins are attractive for quantum technologies, being readily chip-scalable and not subject to the small photon budgets of single emitters. However, realising electrical spin readout in wide-bandgap materials with similar fidelity and bandwidth to optical approaches remains challenging.

arxiv-2511-08475.title: Designing LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems for Software Engineering Tasks: Quality Attributes, Design Patterns and Rationale DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Journal: TOSEM Volume: 0 0 0 0 CCS: Software and its engineering Designing software
arxiv-2511-08475.creator: Yangxiao Cai, Ruiyin Li, Peng Liang, Mojtaba Shahin, Zengyang Li
arxiv-2511-08475.description: Abstract . As the complexity of Software Engineering (SE) tasks continues to escalate, Multi-Agent Systems (MASs) have emerged as a focal point of research and practice due to their autonomy and scalability. Furthermore, through leveraging the reasoning and planning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), the application of LLM-based MASs in the field of SE is garnering increasing attention.

arxiv-2512-12952.title: Leveraging Compression to Construct Transferable Bitrate Ladders
arxiv-2512-12952.creator: Krishna Srikar Durbha, Hassene Tmar, Ping-Hao Wu, Ioannis Katsavounidis, Alan C. Bovik
arxiv-2512-12952.description: Abstract Over the past few years, per-title and per-shot video encoding techniques have demonstrated significant gains as compared to conventional techniques such as constant CRF encoding and the fixed bitrate ladder. These techniques have demonstrated that constructing content-gnostic per-shot bitrate ladders can provide significant bitrate gains and improved Quality of Experience (QoE) for viewers under various network conditions.

pmc-10741751.title: Autologous Faecal Microbiota Transplantation to Improve Outcomes of Haematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: Results of a Single-Centre Feasibility Study
pmc-10741751.creator: Anna Li, Joanne M Bowen, Imogen A Ball, Sophie Wilson, Angelina Yong, David T Yeung, Cindy H Lee, Robert V Bryant, Samuel P Costello, Feargal J Ryan, Hannah R Wardill, Carmine Stolfi, Federica Laudisi
pmc-10741751.description: Haematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) is a curative approach for blood cancers, yet its efficacy is undermined by a range of acute and chronic complications. In light of mounting evidence to suggest that these complications are linked to a dysbiotic gut microbiome, we aimed to evaluate the feasibility of faecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) delivered during the acute phase after HSCT.

pmc-11298315.title: Integrating single‐cell transcriptomics and machine learning to predict breast cancer prognosis: A study based on natural killer cell‐related genes
pmc-11298315.creator: Juanjuan Mao, Ling‐lin Liu, Qian Shen, Mengyan Cen
pmc-11298315.description: Breast cancer (BC) is the most commonly diagnosed cancer in women globally. Natural killer (NK) cells play a vital role in tumour immunosurveillance. This study aimed to establish a prognostic model using NK cell‐related genes (NKRGs) by integrating single‐cell transcriptomic data with machine learning. We identified 44 significantly expressed NKRGs involved in cytokine and T cell‐related functions.

pmc-12630839.title: PBMC proteome is altered in children with high body fat percentage
pmc-12630839.creator: Maya Petek, Tjaša Hertiš Petek, Uroš Potočnik, Nataša Marčun Varda
pmc-12630839.description: Obesity in children is an increasing public health issue. Excess adipose tissue, especially in the form of visceral obesity, is associated with poorer cardiometabolic health, persistent low-grade inflammation and oxidative stress. Mass-spectrometry based analysis of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) can reveal changes associated with dietary patterns, inflammatory diseases and obesity in adults.

pmc-13070465.title: Protective Human Papillomavirus Type 16/18 Vaccine–Induced Neutralizing Antibody Levels Remain Elusive
pmc-13070465.creator: Matti Lehtinen, Tiina Eriksson, Tiina Petäjä, Katja Harjula, Kaisa Heikkilä, Mari Hokkanen, Julia Butt, Birgitta Michels, Peter Sehr, Martin Müller, Ville Pimenoff, Tim Waterboer
pmc-13070465.description: We studied human papillomavirus antibodies in a subset of a cohort comprising 16 988 women who received human papillomavirus (HPV) 16/18 vaccination as adolescents, among whom 50 cervical high-grade squamous cell intraepithelial lesions (HSILs) were diagnosed by 28 years of age.

pmc-13428662.title: Computed tomography findings of peritoneal tumour in the absence of primary lesions: preliminary study
pmc-13428662.creator: T Tanaka, M Tomihari, T Hasegawa
pmc-13428662.description: Primary peritoneal tumours are uncommon and include mesothelioma and carcinoma. Mesothelioma identification is challenging, as there are no established rapid diagnostic methods. In the absence of a simple means of diagnosis, evaluation often requires several invasive biopsies, highlighting the need to develop a definitive diagnostic method.
